finite_coverage_theorem.lifting: A named weight<=10 mechanism on C(S) maps by the inverse translation to a distinct-name mechanism of equal weight, zero syndrome, and nontrivial logical class on S.
finite_coverage_theorem.root_use: UNSAT of the checked quotient plus sound base exclusions would prove every legal schedule has a weight<=10 direct mechanism; SAT supplies only a canonical candidate.
finite_coverage_theorem.statement: For every bounded legal Gross schedule S, the finite orbit {d.S : d in Z_12 x Z_6} has a unique least schedule vector C(S). C(S) satisfies all 71 lex leaders. If multiple group elements attain C(S), they differ by the stabilizer and yield the same schedule vector.
